On-device notebooksNo account requiredIndependent study

Give each rehearsal a clear starting point.

The One-Song Character Notebook keeps your own preparation organised. Record brief notes in your own words and refer back to the original source.

Understand your source

Keep a song label, credits, character details and short source references. The app does not supply official songs or complete lyrics.

Keep versions distinct

Add a new plan version when your preparation changes. Earlier versions and their related records stay separate.

Record what happened

Attach an observation or a planned future check to its plan version. An unknown detail stays unknown; a plan is not a completed performance.

Different songs. Separate notebooks.

Save up to six named notebooks on this device. Select a saved notebook, then choose Load to work on it. Save your changes when you want to keep them.

Illustrative notebook names. Saving is local; this is not a cloud backup or automatic synchronisation service.

Before you begin

Is this an official examination app?

No. Musical Theatre Entry is independently developed by RushLabs. It does not approve repertoire, assess a performance or certify readiness. Consult the examination provider for current requirements.

Does it include songs, scripts or audio?

It provides original knowledge practice and a notebook for your own short notes. Official songs, complete lyrics, scripts and audio recordings are not supplied.

Where are my notes saved?

The notebook saves to the device when you choose Save. There is no account or cloud synchronisation. Keep separate copies of anything you cannot afford to lose.

Will I need a subscription?

The planned release is a paid download that includes the bundled study content and local notebooks. No subscription is enabled. Pricing and availability will be shown in the store when the app is released.
